tagline: Estimate-first research across selected public discussions.
description: Grapevine is a local library and agent skill for investigating selected public discussions. Lite currently covers YouTube comments with estimate-first queries and local regex scoring. The upcoming Pro edition expands to selected community sources with bounded collection, evidence triage, and source-linked briefs. It runs on demand, not as an always-on service.
capabilities: Estimate the work before querying YouTube comments.
Score observations locally with regex rules and review results in an inbox.
Run an on-demand research workflow without an always-on service.
